ADMIN_TAB_DESC: How tall and how wide admins may make characters with /setheight and /setwidth.
ADMIN_C_LIMITS_DESC: Only the look changes: hitboxes, collisions and aiming stay at the normal size; some animations and sitting in a vehicle show the normal size for a moment; wider characters glitch more than taller or shorter ones.
ADMIN_C_HEIGHT_DESC: 1 is the normal height; the character keeps it on every server restart.
ADMIN_H_HEIGHT_ON: Off: /setheight is refused (sizes already set stay).
ADMIN_H_MIN_HEIGHT: The shortest a character can be made (0.85 = 15 % shorter).
ADMIN_H_MAX_HEIGHT: The tallest a character can be made (1.1 = 10 % taller).
ADMIN_C_WIDTH_DESC: Width scales on top of height; it glitches more, so it starts switched off.
ADMIN_H_WIDTH_ON: Off: /setwidth is refused and widths are drawn as normal.
ADMIN_H_MIN_WIDTH: The thinnest a character can be made.
ADMIN_H_MAX_WIDTH: The widest a character can be made.
ADMIN_H_DISTANCE: Other players' sizes are drawn this close; further away everyone looks normal (saves client time).
COMMAND_RESET: Give a character the normal size again
ERR_HEIGHT_OFF: Height changes are switched off in the admin panel.
ERR_WIDTH_OFF: Width changes are switched off in the admin panel.
ERR_RANGE: The size must be between {0} and {1}.
